title: Recognition-memory asymmetries predicted by individual item memorability
authors: Igor Utochkin, Nicholas Chiang, Wilma A. Bainbridge
venue: Journal of Experimental Psychology: General (figure from the PsyArXiv preprint 6n74d, version 3, 2026)
caption_short: (a) Study phase: 120 objects from list A or list B. (b) Old / new test: all 240 objects, each a target or a foil depending on the list studied. (c) Forced-choice test: fixed pairs of one list-A and one list-B object; the participant indicates the location of the old object.
